description: OpenLLMetry Anthropic chat whose prompt token count excludes cache, so the safety net adds it back.
notes: hand-written from opentelemetry-instrumentation-anthropic 0.63.0 (tracer opentelemetry.instrumentation.anthropic, span anthropic.chat). D113: OpenLLMetry Anthropic input is treated as inclusive and the safety net corrects an exclusive count. prompt_tokens is smaller than cache_read, so input_tokens gains the cache and the warning is input_excludes_cache. The current instrumentor adds cache into the input count itself. Re-check against a B2 capture.
